title: AutoSR: Automatic Symbolic Regression by Searching Research States
abstract: arXiv:2608.16876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Automatic Symbolic Regression (AutoSR), a fully automated system that instantiates Research-Space Symbolic Regression by searching persistent scientific investigations rather than isolated equations. Finite, noisy data often yield numerically competitive expressions that imply very different behavior outside the observed regime, making numerical fit and syntactic complexity insufficient measures of scientific credibility. Existing approaches largely focus on improving expressions, yet the search typically retains little beyond the resulting formula and score, losing the scientific record, such as motivations and probes, that inform what to try next. AutoSR preserves this record in a \textbf{Research State}, coupling each candidate equation with the reasoning, computational evidence, and independent review developed along its branch. Proposer--reviewer agents develop these states under progressive-widening Monte Carlo tree

translated_title: AutoSR：通过搜索研究状态实现自动符号回归
translated_abstract: 我们引入了自动符号回归（AutoSR），这是一个全自动系统，它通过搜索持续的科学调查而非孤立的方程来实例化研究空间符号回归。有限且含噪声的数据往往会产生数值上具有竞争力但观测范围之外行为差异很大的表达式，这使得数值拟合和句法复杂性不足以衡量科学可信度。现有方法主要侧重于改进表达式，但搜索通常只保留结果公式和评分，丢失了科学记录，如动机和探测信息，而这些信息有助于决定下一步尝试。AutoSR将这些记录保存在一个“研究状态”中，将每个候选方程与其分支中发展的推理、计算证据和独立审查相结合。提议者-审查者代理在渐进加宽的蒙特卡洛树下开发这些状态。
tldr: AutoSR通过将科学记录保留在研究状态中，并利用提议者-审查者代理在渐进加宽蒙特卡洛树下进行搜索，实现了全自动的符号回归，从而超越了仅关注数值拟合和表达式复杂性的传统方法。
en_tdlr: AutoSR achieves fully automated symbolic regression by preserving scientific records in a Research State and using proposer-reviewer agents under progressive-widening Monte Carlo tree search, surpassing traditional methods that focus solely on numerical fit and expression complexity.
